A '''boring-laser''',<ref name="Scavenger">[[Scavenger Hunt (adventure)|''Scavenger Hunt'']]</ref> also known as '''boring laser''',<ref name="Death">''[[Death in the Undercity]]''</ref> was a [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] employed by the [[Ugor/Legends|Ugor]].<ref name="Scavenger" />

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The boring-laser first appeared in [[Scavenger Hunt (adventure)|''Scavenger Hunt'']], a [[1989]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure authored by [[Brad Freeman]] and published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Scavenger" /> [[Michael Nystul]]'s [[1990]] adventure ''[[Death in the Undercity]]'' later introduced an alternate spelling for the device's name and also included an illustration of it by [[Cathleen Hunter]].<ref name="Death" />
